# 1. Configuración

## 1.1 Librerías

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(
  rmarkdown, knitr,
  gt, flextable, gtsummary,
  PMCMRplus,
  umap,
  vegan,
  phyloseq,
  lattice,
  scales, ggrepel, patchwork, ggpubr, ggplot2,
  VennDiagram, UpSetR,
  rlang, stringr, tidyr, purrr, tibble,
  cowplot, grid, dplyr
)
```

## 1.2 Carga de objetos limpios

Los objetos se cargan desde `Data/processed/`, generados por el archivo
`01_Data_Cleaning.Rmd`:

```{r load_objects, include=FALSE}
gen_path  = getwd()
gen_path  = gsub("notebooks", "", gen_path)
data_path = paste0(gen_path, "Data")
proc_path = paste0(data_path, "/processed")

HMilkclean_filtered = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/HMilkclean_filtered.rds"))
HMilk_clean_genus   = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/HMilk_clean_genus.rds"))
HMS_rarefied        = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/HMS_rarefied.rds"))

metadata = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/metadata_clean.rds"))
df = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/df_clean.rds"))

otu_raw = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/otu_raw.rds"))
tax_raw = readRDS(paste0(proc_path, "/tax_raw.rds"))

mis_rds = readRDS(paste0(data_path, "/paleta_colores_generos.rds"))

cat("Objetos cargados correctamente.\n")
cat("Muestras (filtrado):", nsamples(HMilkclean_filtered), "\n")
cat("Individuos:", length(unique(df$p_code)), "\n")
```

# 2. Tablas resumen de la cohorte

## 2.1 Variables de información por tiempo

```{r labels, include=FALSE}
info_labels = list(
  ab_mom  ~ "Maternal Antibiotics",
  f_type  ~ "Feeding Type",
  pro_bio ~ "Probiotic Consumption"
)

maternal_labels = list(
  ab_gest ~ "Gestation Antibiotics",
  ab_birth ~ "Birth Antibiotics",
  s_bmi   ~ "Maternal BMI (end of pregnancy)",
  s_bmi_c ~ "Maternal BMI Category"
)

infant_labels = list(
  b_type     ~ "Birth Type",
  ab_baby    ~ "Infant Antibiotics",
  bm_excl    ~ "Exclusive Breastfeeding",
  animal_cont ~ "Animal Contact",
  daycare    ~ "Daycare Attendance",
  gest_week  ~ "Gestational Week",
  colic      ~ "Colic",
  b_bh       ~ "Birth Height (cm)",
  g_index    ~ "Growth Index"
)

info_vars     = sapply(info_labels, function(x) as.character(x[[2]]))
maternal_vars = sapply(maternal_labels, function(x) as.character(x[[2]]))
infant_vars   = sapply(infant_labels, function(x) as.character(x[[2]]))

cont_vars = c("gest_week", "b_bh", "g_index")
```

```{r summary_tables, include=FALSE}
df_filtrado_info = df %>%
  group_by(p_code, samp_n) %>%
  summarise(
    time_ = case_when(
      samp_n == 1 ~ "I",
      samp_n == 2 ~ "II",
      samp_n == 3 ~ "III"
    ),
    ab_mom  = names(sort(table(ab_mom), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    f_type  = names(sort(table(f_type), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    pro_bio = names(sort(table(pro_bio), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(info_vars), time_)

df_filtrado_mater = df %>%
  select(all_of(maternal_vars), p_code, samp_n) %>%
  group_by(p_code) %>%
  summarise(
    s_bmi    = round(mean(s_bmi, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    ab_gest  = names(sort(table(ab_gest), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    ab_birth = names(sort(table(ab_birth), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    s_bmi_c  = names(sort(table(s_bmi_c), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_infant_resumen = df %>%
  select(all_of(infant_vars), p_code, samp_n) %>%
  group_by(p_code) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(samp_n) >= 2) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(cont_vars), ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 4), .names = "{.col}"),
    across(
      setdiff(infant_vars, cont_vars),
      ~ names(sort(table(.x), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      .names = "{.col}"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

La **Tabla 1** resume las características clínicas y nutricionales de la
cohorte a través de los tres puntos temporales (I, II, III). La muestra
presenta gran estabilidad en sus hábitos: la exposición a antibióticos
maternos es mínima (>94% negativos), la lactancia materna exclusiva se
mantiene como vía predominante (~61%), y el consumo de probióticos se
reporta en poco más de un tercio (35-38%).

```{r, eval=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-re12
#| tbl-cap: "Resumen de las variables de información por tiempo de muestreo."

df_filtrado_info %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = time_,
    label = info_labels,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  bold_labels()
```

La **Tabla 2** presenta los antecedentes maternos de la cohorte completa
($N=51$). La exposición a antibióticos durante la gestación fue baja
(16%), mientras que en el momento del parto abarcó a la mayoría (63%).
El IMC materno al final del embarazo promedió 16.85 (rango: 14.09 –
19.98).

```{r, eval=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-res523-madre
#| tbl-cap: "Resumen de las variables maternas durante el embarazo."

df_filtrado_mater %>%
  select(all_of(maternal_vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = maternal_labels,
    statistic = list(
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
      all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} [{min} – {max}]"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()
```

La **Tabla 3** describe el perfil clínico y de desarrollo de los infantes
($N=51$). La edad gestacional promedió 38.75 semanas, la talla inicial
49.76 cm, y la vía de parto predominante fue cesárea (57%). El índice de
crecimiento poblacional registró un valor medio de 10.89 (rango: 8.94 –
13.06).

```{r, eval=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-resdf47665
#| tbl-cap: "Resumen de las variables del infante durante su desarrollo."

df_infant_resumen %>%
  select(all_of(infant_vars)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = infant_labels,
    type = list(gest_week ~ "continuous"),
    statistic = list(
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
      all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} [{min} – {max}]"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()
```

# 3. Índice de crecimiento (descriptivo)

## 3.1 Test de Skillings-Mack

Para determinar si existen diferencias significativas en el índice de
crecimiento a través de los puntos temporales, se implementó el test de
Skillings-Mack, alternativa idónea para diseños de medidas repetidas
desbalanceadas:

```{r, include=FALSE}
df = df %>%
  mutate(
    t_time = case_when(
      samp_n == 1 ~ "I",
      samp_n == 2 ~ "II",
      samp_n == 3 ~ "III"
    )
  )
df$t_time = factor(df$t_time, levels = c("I", "II", "III"))

matriz_desbalanceada = xtabs(g_index ~ p_code + t_time, data = df)
matriz_desbalanceada[matriz_desbalanceada == 0] = NA
matriz_limpia = as.matrix(matriz_desbalanceada)

resultado_MackSkill = skillingsMackTest(matriz_limpia)
```

Se encontró suficiente evidencia para rechazar la hipótesis nula de que
el promedio de crecimiento en los 3 tiempos es igual ($\alpha = 0.05$).

## 3.2 Evolución por sexo

```{r, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
#| label: fig-evolucion-peso
#| fig-cap: "Cambio del índice de crecimiento según la edad, observado por persona y sexo."

df$sex = as.factor(df$sex)

xyplot(g_index ~ age_d | sex,
       data = df,
       groups = p_code,
       type = c("p", "a"),
       panel = function(x, y, ...) {
         panel.xyplot(x, y, ...)
         panel.lmline(x, y, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 1)
       },
       key = list(
         space = "top",
         columns = 2,
         text = list(c("Overall Regression by Sex", "By Person")),
         lines = list(col = c("black", "transparent"), lty = 1, lwd = 2),
         points = list(pch = 1, col = c("transparent", "orange"))
       ),
       xlab = "Age in Days",
       ylab = "Patient Growth Index"
)
```

## 3.3 Observaciones con disminución del índice

Algunas unidades muestrales presentaron una reducción del índice de
crecimiento. Estos datos provienen del peso del usuario (factor de la
ecuación del índice), por lo que no representan un error:

```{r}
#| label: tbl-resumen-madre
#| tbl-cap: "Observaciones con disminución posterior del G Index."

datos_reporte = df %>%
  filter(p_code %in% c("MB-011", "MB-024")) %>%
  select(p_code, samp_n, g_index)

flextable(datos_reporte) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    p_code  = "Subject Code",
    samp_n  = "Sample No.",
    g_index = "G Index"
  ) %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  bold(j = "p_code", part = "body")
```

## 3.4 Trayectoria con regresión

La mayor parte de los datos se ajusta a las bandas de confianza. La línea
de regresión y la curva LOESS se mantienen paralelas, aunque destaca una
observación que se desvía notablemente:

```{r}
#| label: fig-tray-crec-edad32
#| fig-cap: "Trayectoria del índice de crecimiento con la edad por tiempo de observación."

df$samp_n = as.factor(df$samp_n)

plot(df$age_d, df$g_index,
     type = "n",
     xlab = "Age in Days",
     ylab = "Patient Growth Index",
     main = "")

grid(col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted")

points(df$age_d[df$samp_n == 1], df$g_index[df$samp_n == 1], pch = 4, col = "black")
points(df$age_d[df$samp_n == 2], df$g_index[df$samp_n == 2], pch = 1, col = "black")
points(df$age_d[df$samp_n == 3], df$g_index[df$samp_n == 3], pch = 2, col = "black")

abline(lm(g_index ~ age_d, data = df), col = "black", lwd = 2)

linea_suave = loess(g_index ~ age_d, data = df)
j = order(df$age_d)
lines(df$age_d[j], predict(linea_suave)[j], col = "black", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("T1 (x)", "T2 (o)", "T3 (Δ)"),
       pch = c(4, 1, 2),
       col = "black",
       bty = "n")
```

# 4. Taxonomía descriptiva

## 4.1 Muestras por tiempo y tipo

```{r, include=FALSE}
sample_info = data.frame(
  sam_id = colnames(otu_raw),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sample_info$type_sample = ifelse(startsWith(sample_info$sam_id, "ML"), "Leches", "Heces")
sample_info$time = ifelse(
  endsWith(sample_info$sam_id, "-I"), "I",
  ifelse(endsWith(sample_info$sam_id, "-II"), "II", "III")
)
```

```{r, include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-muestras-tipo
#| tbl-cap: "Cantidad de observaciones por tiempo y tipo de muestra."

table(sample_info$time, sample_info$type_sample)
```

```{r}

  table(sample_info$time, sample_info$type_sample)[, 2]
```

## 4.7 Resumen por nivel taxonómico

```{r}
tax_df = as.data.frame(tax_raw)

resumen_niveles = lapply(colnames(tax_df), function(nivel) {
  datos_nivel = tax_df[[nivel]]
  total_asvs = length(datos_nivel)
  clasificados = sum(!is.na(datos_nivel) & datos_nivel != "" & datos_nivel != "unclassified")
  nas = total_asvs - clasificados
  
  data.frame(
    Nivel = nivel,
    Total_ASVs = total_asvs,
    Clasificados = clasificados,
    No_Clasificados_NA = nas,
    Porcentaje_Exito = round((clasificados / total_asvs) * 100, 2),
    Riqueza_Taxones_Unicos = length(unique(na.omit(datos_nivel[datos_nivel != ""])))
  )
})

tabla_final = do.call(rbind, resumen_niveles)
colnames(tabla_final) = c("Level", "Total ASVs", "Classified",
                          "Unclassified (NA)", "Success Percentage (%)",
                          "Unique Taxa Richness")

flextable(tabla_final) %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header")
```

# 5. Índices de diversidad

## 5.1 Cálculo

```{r, include=FALSE}
diversity_indices = estimate_richness(
  HMS_rarefied,
  measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")
)

diversity_indices$type_of_sample = ifelse(
  startsWith(rownames(diversity_indices), "MH"), "Stool", "Milk"
)

diversity_indices = diversity_indices %>%
  mutate(
    time_of_sample = case_when(
      endsWith(rownames(diversity_indices), ".I")   ~ "T1",
      endsWith(rownames(diversity_indices), ".II")  ~ "T2",
      endsWith(rownames(diversity_indices), ".III") ~ "T3"
    ),
    time_of_sample = factor(time_of_sample, levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"))
  )

small_constant = 1e-9
diversity_indices = diversity_indices %>%
  mutate(
    Simpson_adjusted = case_when(
      Simpson == 0 ~ Simpson + small_constant,
      Simpson == 1 ~ Simpson - small_constant,
      TRUE ~ Simpson
    ),
    logit_Simpson = log(Simpson_adjusted / (1 - Simpson_adjusted))
  )

# Identificador del paciente (para pruebas pareadas) y orden para el emparejamiento
diversity_indices$p_code = sub("^(ML|MH)", "MB", rownames(diversity_indices))
diversity_indices = diversity_indices %>% arrange(p_code, time_of_sample)
```

## 5.2 Distribución por tiempo

La microbiota intestinal del bebé gana diversidad a medida que crece,
mientras que la diversidad de la leche materna disminuye o se estabiliza:

```{r, include=FALSE}
add_div_tests = function(y_global, y_pair, step_inc = 0.05) {
  list(
    # Prueba global Kruskal-Wallis
    stat_compare_means(
      method = "kruskal.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      y.position = y_global
    ),
    # Comparaciones pareadas con corrección de Holm
    stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox.test",
      comparisons = list(c("T1", "T2"), c("T2", "T3"), c("T1", "T3")),
      p.adjust.method = "holm",
      label = "p.signif",
      y.position = y_pair,
      step.increase = step_inc
    )
  )
}

# (A) Simpson en Heces
p1_s = diversity_indices %>%
  filter(type_of_sample == "Stool") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_sample, y = logit_Simpson)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "logit(SDI)", x = "Time Point", title = "Infant Stool") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 5.2)) +
  add_div_tests(y_global = 4.9, y_pair = c(3.7, 4.1, 4.5))

# (B) Simpson en Leche
p2_m = diversity_indices %>%
  filter(type_of_sample == "Milk") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_sample, y = logit_Simpson)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "logit(SDI)", x = "Time Point", title = "Breast Milk") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 5.2)) +
  add_div_tests(y_global = 4.9, y_pair = c(3.7, 4.1, 4.5))

# (C) Shannon en Heces
p3_s = diversity_indices %>%
  filter(type_of_sample == "Stool") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_sample, y = Shannon)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "ShDI", x = "Time Point", title = "Infant Stool") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5.2)) +
  add_div_tests(y_global = 4.9, y_pair = c(3.7, 4.1, 4.5))

# (D) Shannon en Leche
p4_m = diversity_indices %>%
  filter(type_of_sample == "Milk") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_sample, y = Shannon)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "ShDI", x = "Time Point", title = "Breast Milk") +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5.2)) +
  add_div_tests(y_global = 4.9, y_pair = c(3.7, 4.1, 4.5))

# (E) Observed en Heces
p5_s = diversity_indices %>%
  filter(type_of_sample == "Stool") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_sample, y = Observed)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25) +

        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 180)) +
  add_div_tests(y_global = 170, y_pair = c(135, 147, 159))

# (F) Observed en Leche
p6_m = diversity_indices %>%
  filter(type_of_sample == "Milk") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_sample, y = Observed)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25) +
  labs(y = "Observed", x = "Time Point", title = "Breast Milk") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 180)) +
  add_div_tests(y_global = 170, y_pair = c(135, 147, 159))
```

# 6. Ordenación descriptiva

## 6.1 Preparación de datos (abundancia relativa)

```{r, include=FALSE}
ps_relative = transform_sample_counts(HMilkclean_filtered, function(x) x / sum(x))

df_ps = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_relative))
taxa_info = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_relative))

taxa_genus = taxa_info$Genus
taxa_genus[is.na(taxa_genus)] = "unclassified"
row.names(df_ps) = make.unique(as.character(taxa_genus))

asv_df_T = as.data.frame(t(df_ps))
asv_df_T[] = lapply(asv_df_T, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

asv_df_genus = asv_df_T %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sam_id") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = case_when(
      startsWith(sam_id, "MH") ~ "Stool",
      startsWith(sam_id, "ML") ~ "Milk",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    time = case_when(
      endsWith(sam_id, "-I")   ~ "I",
      endsWith(sam_id, "-II")  ~ "II",
      endsWith(sam_id, "-III") ~ "III"
    ),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("I", "II", "III"))
  )

cluster_by_time_type = split(
  asv_df_genus,
  f = list(asv_df_genus$sample_type, asv_df_genus$time),
  sep = "_"
)
cluster_by_time_type = cluster_by_time_type[sapply(cluster_by_time_type, nrow) > 0]
```

## 6.2 PCoA por tiempo y tipo

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
generar_plot_pcoa = function(datos_asv, nombre_grupo, color_puntos = "darkblue") {
  bray_dist_matrix = vegdist(datos_asv, method = "bray")
  pcoa_res = cmdscale(bray_dist_matrix, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  pve = round(100 * pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig), 1)
  
  pcoa_df = data.frame(
    Axis1 = pcoa_res$points[, 1],
    Axis2 = pcoa_res$points[, 2]
  )
  
  ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = color_puntos) +
    labs(
      title = paste("PCoA", nombre_grupo, "(Bray-Curtis)"),
      x = paste0("PCo1 (", pve[1], "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCo2 (", pve[2], "%)")
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

pca1 = generar_plot_pcoa(cluster_by_time_type[["Milk_I"]]   %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Milk I")
pca2 = generar_plot_pcoa(cluster_by_time_type[["Milk_II"]]  %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Milk II")
pca3 = generar_plot_pcoa(cluster_by_time_type[["Milk_III"]] %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Milk III")
pca4 = generar_plot_pcoa(cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_I"]]  %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Stool I")
pca5 = generar_plot_pcoa(cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_II"]] %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Stool II")
pca6 = generar_plot_pcoa(cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_III"]]%>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Stool III")

(pca1 + pca4) /
(pca2 + pca5) /
(pca3 + pca6)
```

## 6.3 UMAP por tiempo y tipo

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
generar_plot_umap = function(datos_asv, nombre_grupo,
                             vecinos = 5, dist_min = 0.1,
                             semilla = 1234, color_puntos = "seagreen") {
  d = vegdist(datos_asv, method = "bray")
  cfg = umap.defaults
  cfg$input       = "dist"
  cfg$n_neighbors = vecinos
  cfg$min_dist    = dist_min
  
  set.seed(semilla)
  res = umap(as.matrix(d), config = cfg)
  
  df = data.frame(UMAP1 = res$layout[, 1], UMAP2 = res$layout[, 2])
  
  ggplot(df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = color_puntos) +
    labs(title = paste0("UMAP ", nombre_grupo), x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    theme_minimal()
}

pca1 = generar_plot_umap(cluster_by_time_type[["Milk_I"]]   %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Milk I")
pca2 = generar_plot_umap(cluster_by_time_type[["Milk_II"]]  %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Milk II")
pca3 = generar_plot_umap(cluster_by_time_type[["Milk_III"]] %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Milk III")
pca4 = generar_plot_umap(cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_I"]]  %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Stool I")
pca5 = generar_plot_umap(cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_II"]] %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Stool II")
pca6 = generar_plot_umap(cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_III"]]%>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time), "Stool III")

(pca1 + pca4) /
(pca2 + pca5) /
(pca3 + pca6)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Leches
datos_trayectoriaMilk = asv_df_genus %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Milk") %>%
  mutate(paciente_id = sub("-[^-]+$", "", sam_id)) %>%
  arrange(paciente_id, time)

metadatosMilk = datos_trayectoriaMilk %>%
  select(sam_id, sample_type, time, paciente_id)

asv_numeric_traj1 = datos_trayectoriaMilk %>%
  select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time, -paciente_id)
asv_numeric_traj1[] = lapply(asv_numeric_traj1, as.numeric)
filas_validas = rowSums(asv_numeric_traj1) > 0
asv_numeric_traj1 = asv_numeric_traj1[filas_validas, ]
asv_numeric_traj1 = asv_numeric_traj1[, colSums(asv_numeric_traj1) > 0]
metadatosMilk = metadatosMilk[filas_validas, ]

bray_dist_traj = vegdist(asv_numeric_traj1, method = "bray")
pcoa_res = cmdscale(bray_dist_traj, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
var_explicada = round(pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig) * 100, 1)
pcoa_coords_milk = as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
colnames(pcoa_coords_milk) = c("PCo1", "PCo2")
plot_data_milk = bind_cols(metadatosMilk, pcoa_coords_milk)

# Heces

  filter(sample_type == "Stool") %>%

  arrange(paciente_id, time)

metadatosStool = datos_trayectoriaStool %>%

asv_numeric_traj2 = datos_trayectoriaStool %>%

asv_numeric_traj2[] = lapply(asv_numeric_traj2, as.numeric)

asv_numeric_traj2 = asv_numeric_traj2[filas_validas, ]
asv_numeric_traj2 = asv_numeric_traj2[, colSums(asv_numeric_traj2) > 0]
metadatosStool = metadatosStool[filas_validas, ]

bray_dist_traj = vegdist(asv_numeric_traj2, method = "bray")
```

# 7. Dinámica de abundancia

## 7.1 Preparación de datos

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Abundancia relativa a nivel género
asv_df_p = tax_glom(HMilkclean_filtered, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
asv_df_prev = as.data.frame(otu_table(asv_df_p))

taxa_info = as.data.frame(tax_table(asv_df_p))
taxa_genus = taxa_info$Genus
taxa_genus[is.na(taxa_genus)] = "unclassified"
row.names(asv_df_prev) = make.unique(as.character(taxa_genus))
asv_df_prev = as.data.frame(t(asv_df_prev))

# Alinear con metadatos
muestras_comunes = intersect(rownames(asv_df_prev), rownames(metadata))
abundancia_df = asv_df_prev[muestras_comunes, ]
metadata = metadata[muestras_comunes, ]

abundancia_df = abundancia_df %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "id") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    startsWith(id, "ML") ~ "Milk",
    startsWith(id, "MH") ~ "Stool"
  ))

# Leches
maas_leches = abundancia_df %>%
  filter(type == "Milk") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "id") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

# Heces
maas_heces = abundancia_df %>%
  filter(type == "Stool") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "id") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))
```

## 7.2 Boxplots por tipo de parto

```{r, include=FALSE}
rel_leches = sweep(maas_leches, 1, rowSums(maas_leches), "/")
largo_leches = rel_leches %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -id, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundancia") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% rownames_to_column(var = "id") %>% select(id, b_type), by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(b_type))

top10_milk = largo_leches %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(media = mean(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(media)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Taxon)

rel_heces = sweep(maas_heces, 1, rowSums(maas_heces), "/")
largo_heces = rel_heces %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -id, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundancia") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% rownames_to_column(var = "id") %>% select(id, b_type), by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(b_type))

top10_heces = largo_heces %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(media = mean(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(media)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Taxon)
```

```{r}
largo_leches %>%

             y = Log_Abundancia, fill = b_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Vaginal" = "#D4A2C3", "Cesarean" = "#2A5783")) +
```

```{r}
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```

## 7.3 Áreas por tiempo y tipo de parto

```{r, include=FALSE}
largo_heces = largo_heces %>%
  mutate(time = case_when(
    endsWith(id, "-I")   ~ "I",
    endsWith(id, "-II")  ~ "II",
    endsWith(id, "-III") ~ "III"
  ))

top15_taxones_h = largo_heces %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(Media = mean(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Media)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Taxon)

datos_areas_h = largo_heces %>%
  mutate(Taxon_Top = if_else(Taxon %in% top15_taxones_h, Taxon, "Other")) %>%
  mutate(time_num = case_when(time == "I" ~ 1, time == "II" ~ 2, time == "III" ~ 3)) %>%
  group_by(id, time_num, b_type, Taxon_Top) %>%
  summarise(Abundancia_Paciente = sum(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(time_num, b_type, Taxon_Top) %>%
  summarise(Abundancia_Promedio = mean(Abundancia_Paciente), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Taxon_Top = factor(Taxon_Top, levels = c("Other", top15_taxones_h)))

largo_leches = largo_leches %>%
  mutate(time = case_when(
    endsWith(id, "-I")   ~ "I",
    endsWith(id, "-II")  ~ "II",
    endsWith(id, "-III") ~ "III"
  ))

top15_taxones_l = largo_leches %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(Media = mean(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Media)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Taxon)

datos_areas_l = largo_leches %>%
  mutate(Taxon_Top = if_else(Taxon %in% top15_taxones_l, Taxon, "Other")) %>%
  mutate(time_num = case_when(time == "I" ~ 1, time == "II" ~ 2, time == "III" ~ 3)) %>%
  group_by(id, time_num, b_type, Taxon_Top) %>%
  summarise(Abundancia_Paciente = sum(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(time_num, b_type, Taxon_Top) %>%
  summarise(Abundancia_Promedio = mean(Abundancia_Paciente), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Taxon_Top = factor(Taxon_Top, levels = c("Other", top15_taxones_l)))
```

## 7.4 Microorganismos específicos

```{r, include=FALSE}
plot_microbe_abundance = function(microbe_name, data) {
  pd = position_dodge(width = 0.15)
  
  data %>%
    filter(Taxon == microbe_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = Abundancia, color = b_type,
               fill = b_type, linetype = b_type, group = b_type)) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "line", size = 1, position = pd) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.max = ~quantile(., 0.75),
      fun.min = ~quantile(., 0.25),
      fun = median,
      geom = "pointrange",
      size = 0.8,
      position = pd
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(microbe_name),
      fill = "Type of birth",
      linetype = "Type of birth",
      color = "Type of birth",
      x = "Time",
      y = "Relative Abundance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("I", "II", "III")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

# 8. Concordancia díada

Se evalúa si la microbiota de la leche materna de una madre se asemeja
más a la de su propio hijo que a la de otros (análisis intra vs. inter
díada).

## 8.1 Similitud Bray-Curtis

```{r, include=FALSE}
HMilk_rel = transform_sample_counts(HMilk_clean_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))

meta = as(sample_data(HMilk_rel), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

valid_dyads = meta %>%
  filter(type %in% c("Milk", "Stool")) %>%
  group_by(samp_n, p_code) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_types == 2)

calc_dyad_summary = function(ps_obj, time_point, metric = "bray") {
  dyads_t = valid_dyads %>%
    filter(samp_n == time_point) %>%
    pull(p_code)
  
  meta_t = meta %>%
    filter(samp_n == time_point, p_code %in% dyads_t, type %in% c("Milk", "Stool"))
  
  ps_sub = prune_samples(meta_t$sample_id, ps_obj)
  
  dist_mat = as.matrix(phyloseq::distance(ps_sub, method = metric))
  sim_mat = 1 - dist_mat
  
  milk_samps = meta_t %>% filter(type == "Milk") %>% arrange(p_code)
  stool_samps = meta_t %>% filter(type == "Stool") %>% arrange(p_code)
  
  common_p = sort(intersect(milk_samps$p_code, stool_samps$p_code))
  milk_samps = milk_samps %>% filter(p_code %in% common_p)
  stool_samps = stool_samps %>% filter(p_code %in% common_p)
  
  sub_sim = sim_mat[milk_samps$sample_id, stool_samps$sample_id]
  rownames(sub_sim) = common_p
  colnames(sub_sim) = common_p
  
  res_dyad = purrr::map_dfr(common_p, function(id) {
    sim_intra = sub_sim[id, id]
    sim_inter_avg = mean(sub_sim[id, colnames(sub_sim) != id])
    
    tibble(
      p_code = id,
      time = time_point,
      sim_intra = sim_intra,
      sim_inter_avg = sim_inter_avg,
      diff = sim_intra - sim_inter_avg
    )
  })
  
  return(res_dyad)
}

times = sort(unique(valid_dyads$samp_n))
dyad_paired_df = purrr::map_dfr(times, ~calc_dyad_summary(HMilk_rel, time_point = .x, metric = "bray"))

test_results_paired = dyad_paired_df %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dyads = n(),
    mean_diff = mean(diff),
    median_diff = median(diff),
    p_value = wilcox.test(sim_intra, sim_inter_avg, paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

$H_0: \Delta_i = S_{\text{intra}, i} - \bar{S}_{\text{inter}, i} = 0$

$H_1: \Delta_i = S_{\text{intra}, i} - \bar{S}_{\text{inter}, i} > 0$

No hay suficiente evidencia para rechazar la hipótesis nula de que la
relación de microorganismos de una madre se asocia de igual manera a los
de otras observaciones ($\alpha = 0.05$).

```{r}
cbind(test_results_paired[, 1], round(test_results_paired[, 2:5], 4)) %>%
  gt()
```

## 8.2 Jaccard y conteo compartido

```{r, include=FALSE}
calc_qualitative_overlap = function(ps_obj, time_point) {
  dyads_t = valid_dyads %>%
    filter(samp_n == time_point) %>%
    pull(p_code)
  
  meta_t = meta %>%
    filter(samp_n == time_point, p_code %in% dyads_t, type %in% c("Milk", "Stool"))
  
  ps_sub = prune_samples(meta_t$sample_id, ps_obj)
  
  otu_tab = as(otu_table(ps_sub), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_sub)) otu_tab = t(otu_tab)
  otu_bin = (otu_tab > 0) * 1
  
  milk_meta = meta_t %>% filter(type == "Milk") %>% arrange(p_code)
  stool_meta = meta_t %>% filter(type == "Stool") %>% arrange(p_code)
  
  common_p = sort(intersect(milk_meta$p_code, stool_meta$p_code))
  milk_meta = milk_meta %>% filter(p_code %in% common_p)
  stool_meta = stool_meta %>% filter(p_code %in% common_p)
  
  milk_mat = otu_bin[, milk_meta$sample_id]
  stool_mat = otu_bin[, stool_meta$sample_id]
  colnames(milk_mat) = milk_meta$p_code
  colnames(stool_mat) = stool_meta$p_code
  
  shared_counts = t(milk_mat) %*% stool_mat
  
  milk_totals = colSums(milk_mat)
  stool_totals = colSums(stool_mat)
  
  union_mat = outer(milk_totals, stool_totals, "+") - shared_counts
  jaccard_mat = shared_counts / union_mat
  
  res = purrr::map_dfr(common_p, function(id) {
    count_intra = shared_counts[id, id]
    count_inter_avg = mean(shared_counts[id, colnames(shared_counts) != id])
    jaccard_intra = jaccard_mat[id, id]
    jaccard_inter_avg = mean(jaccard_mat[id, colnames(jaccard_mat) != id])
    
    tibble(
      p_code = id,
      time = time_point,
      count_intra = count_intra,
      count_inter_avg = count_inter_avg,
      count_diff = count_intra - count_inter_avg,
      jaccard_intra = jaccard_intra,
      jaccard_inter_avg = jaccard_inter_avg,
      jaccard_diff = jaccard_intra - jaccard_inter_avg
    )
  })
  
  return(res)
}

qual_results = purrr::map_dfr(times, ~calc_qualitative_overlap(HMilk_clean_genus, time_point = .x))

qual_summary = qual_results %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dyads = n(),
    median_count_intra = median(count_intra),
    median_count_inter = median(count_inter_avg),
    mean_count_diff = mean(count_diff),
    p_val_count = wilcox.test(count_intra, count_inter_avg, paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    median_jaccard_diff = median(jaccard_diff),
    p_val_jaccard = wilcox.test(jaccard_intra, jaccard_inter_avg, paired = TRUE, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Evaluado mediante distancias composicionales (Bray-Curtis), similitud
cualitativa (Jaccard) y conteo pareado de taxones compartidos, no se
observó una concordancia comunitaria intra-díada significativamente mayor
que la esperada por el azar poblacional (todas las $p > 0.10$).

```{r}
cbind(qual_summary[, 1], round(qual_summary[, 2:8], 4)) %>%
  gt()
```

# 9. Taxones compartidos entre compartimentos

Se evalúa la sobreposición de géneros entre la leche materna y las
heces del infante, de forma global (Venn) y por tiempo (upset plot),
siguiendo el diseño de la Figura 1 de referencia.

## 9.1 Preparación de datos (presencia de géneros)

```{r shared_prep, include=FALSE}
# Matriz género x muestra a partir del objeto a nivel género
otu_g = as(otu_table(HMilk_clean_genus), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(HMilk_clean_genus)) otu_g = t(otu_g)
# filas = géneros, columnas = muestras

sd = sample_data(HMilk_clean_genus)
comp = sd$type      # "Milk" / "Stool"
time = sd$samp_n    # "I" / "II" / "III"

# Presencia binaria (género presente si tiene >= 1 lectura)
otu_bin = (otu_g > 0) * 1

# Generos presentes por compartimento (cualquier muestra)
generos_milk  = rownames(otu_bin)[rowSums(otu_bin[, comp == "Milk",  drop = FALSE]) > 0]
generos_stool = rownames(otu_bin)[rowSums(otu_bin[, comp == "Stool", drop = FALSE]) > 0]

# Generos presentes por compartimento x tiempo (sets para el upset)
sets = list()
for (c in c("Milk", "Stool")) {
  for (t in c("I", "II", "III")) {
    idx = which(comp == c & time == t)
    if (length(idx) > 0) {
      sets[[paste0(c, "_", t)]] = rownames(otu_bin)[rowSums(otu_bin[, idx, drop = FALSE]) > 0]
    }
  }
}
sets = sets[lengths(sets) > 0]

cat("Géneros en Leche:", length(generos_milk), "\n")
cat("Géneros en Heces: ", length(generos_stool), "\n")
cat("Compartidos:      ", length(intersect(generos_milk, generos_stool)), "\n")
```

## 9.2 Venn diagrama (Leche vs. Heces)

```{r}
timepoints_ordered = c(
  "Milk_I", "Milk_II", "Milk_III",
  "Stool_I", "Stool_II", "Stool_III"
)

col_milk  = "#2985CC"  # Celeste / Leche
col_stool = "#A294F3"  # Naranja / Heces infante

colores_sets = c(
  rep(col_milk, 3),    # Milk I, II, III
  rep(col_stool, 3)    # Stool I, II, III
)

df_upset = as.data.frame(UpSetR::fromList(sets))

upset_res = upset(
  df_upset,
  sets = rev(timepoints_ordered),
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = TRUE,
  nintersects = 40,
  main.bar.color = "#104E8E",
  sets.bar.color = rev(colores_sets),
  matrix.color = "grey20",
  show.numbers = "yes",
  number.angles = 0,
  mainbar.y.label = "N.º de géneros (Intersección)",
  sets.x.label = "Total por condición",
  text.scale = c(1.3, 1.1, 1, 1, 1.2, 0.95),
  mb.ratio = c(0.55, 0.45)
)


ruta_upset_svg = file.path(fig_dir, "upset.svg")

svglite::svglite(ruta_upset_svg, width = 12, height = 8)
print(upset_res)
dev.off()
```
